mapper.sql: id, quiz_id AS quizId, user_id AS userId, attempt_number AS attemptNumber, status, close_reason AS closeReason, receipt_id AS receiptId, started_at AS startedAt, deadline_at AS deadlineAt, submitted_at AS submittedAt, auto_score AS autoScore, manual_score AS manualScore, total_score AS totalScore, manual_grading_complete AS manualGradingComplete, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_attempt (quiz_id, user_id, attempt_number, status, started_at, deadline_at, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{quizId}, #{userId}, #{attemptNumber}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{deadlineAt}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quiz_attempt WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT FROM quiz_attempt WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('InProgress', 'Finalizing') LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_attempt WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_attempt WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'Submitted'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_attempt WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT FROM quiz_attempt WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY attempt_number DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE quiz_attempt SET status = 'Finalizing', updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'InProgress'
mapper.select: SELECT a.id FROM quiz_attempt a INNER JOIN quiz q ON q.id = a.quiz_id INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = q.course_id LEFT JOIN enrollment e ON e.course_id = q.course_id AND e.user_id = a.user_id AND e.active = 1 WHERE a.status = 'InProgress' AND ( a.deadline_at <= #{nowUtc} OR q.closes_at <= #{nowUtc} OR c.state = 'Archived' OR e.id IS NULL OR e.course_role != 'Student' ) ORDER BY a.deadline_at LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_attempt WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND status = 'Submitted'
SELECT a.id FROM quiz_attempt a INNER JOIN quiz q ON q.id = a.quiz_id WHERE q.course_id = #{courseId} AND a.status = 'InProgress' ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT a.id FROM quiz_attempt a INNER JOIN quiz q ON q.id = a.quiz_id WHERE q.course_id = #{courseId} AND a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 'InProgress' ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}
